verdict: Dump is a research scrapbook. Product intent is Digital Refinery (YouTube → structured action) on EventRelay apps/web. Do not build ADK/LWP/Ultron.
keep: Digital Refinery: video/image/text → structured executable actions, not summaries
YouTube URL as the input gate
Sequential ingest: video → timestamped transcript → downstream
Speech + visual, time-aligned; public URL; Gemini can take a public YouTube URI
Existing stack: Gemini, FastAPI, Next.js, Supabase — extend EventRelay
ignore: Google ADK hierarchy, Bidi-streaming, Loop/Router/Compliance, Tiramisu tools
LWP Common Header, Virtual Port IDs, Command Fate
Ultron Agentic Platform as name or architecture
OPA/Rego, Device Action Language, canvas glyphs
Antigravity newsletter, Cloudflare DNS, agency/CFO theater
gaps_vs_dump: Dump never specifies one-face paste-YouTube then transcript+events on the same page — that is EventRelay P1, not the dump
Dump ‘events’ are LWP ports or SSE progress, not extract-events
Dump ‘act’ is ADK tools, not WDK Act
action: No architecture change. P1 already implements the keep list. Continue P2/P3.
